content.title: love.fútbol
content.text: Donate NOW FROM 100 PROJECTS TO EVERY CHILD Through the power of passion and play, love.fútbol partners with and mobilizes vulnerable communities worldwide to create, reclaim, and redefine sports spaces as inclusive centers of community and lasting platforms for social growth. three core objectives Access to Play A fundamental opportunity for positive, productive and healthy lives. Community Ownership Local residents build their own sports space and with it, their community. Platform for Development The community and local partners harness this energy, social network, and space towards long-term social impact. Learn More 95 Partner Communities 17 Countries 5 Continents +111K Volunteer Hours +138K People Impacted Learn about OUR impact in partner communities Rio Doce, Brazil View Project The community has exceeded its fundraising goal by threefold for the year, enabling consistent maintenance and significant enhancements to the space. The pitch has emerged as a catalyst for several developments in the surrounding area, fostering a thriving sports program, revitalizing streets, and cultivating the growth of new local businesses. James Finnegan, USA View Project Our integrated approach engaged diverse community groups, resulting in a collaborative effort that involved over 200 volunteers representing 10 nationalities. The community generously contributed approximately 20% of the total project costs, showcasing a shared commitment to our collective goals. Sinoni, Tanzania View Project The sports space united 400 community volunteers, gaining substantial attention from national news outlets. Marking a historic milestone, this initiative represents the community's inaugural development of a recreational space, fostering a new era of engagement and activity within the community. Bandepalya, India View Project The sports space engages the community in over five languages. It hosts a multifaceted sports and educational program that tackles crucial topics including gender equality, inclusion, leadership, teamwork, and employability, fostering a nurturing environment that embraces our community's diversity and aspirations.
